description: This source file defines the main page component for a personal notes manager application built with React and Next.js. It manages state for notes, loading status, errors, and handles interactions such as creating, updating, and deleting notes by calling API functions. It renders the main UI including a header, error messages, loading indicator, list of notes via a NoteList component, and a Sidebar for creating new notes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest notes and updates the state.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Creates a new note with the specified title and content, then refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with new title and content, then refreshes the list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the note with the specified id, then refreshes the notes list.
